probe_result: PASS for safety, not liveness, in the exact serialized single-writer symbolic cut. Permissive existence-only recovery produced one resolved duplicate replay, two resolved false skips, and one additional unverifiable false-skip case across seven stale/fresh/partial/identity cases. Strict exact payload+generation/nonce+freshness fencing produced zero resolved false skips and zero duplicate replays by using a three-way decision: confirmed applied -> skip/recover certificate; confirmed fresh absent -> replay; uncertain/conflict -> defer with no semantic action. Five cases deliberately deferred, so exactly-once progress remains unresolved when target-query freshness/completeness or identity cannot be certified.
neuroscience_transfer: Refine the role-local corollary-discharge analogy from binary prediction/observation matching to reliability-gated comparison: an internal self-action prediction should not be canceled by an observation whose provenance or freshness is uncertain. The recurrence analogue is to gate replay/skip on the reliability of target-state feedback, not mere record presence.
mechanism_revision: Certificate absence and target-record presence are both insufficient alone. Safe recurrence after an ambiguous effect requires durable intent plus deterministic effect identity and a freshness/identity-fenced target observation. Uncertain observation must map to DEFER rather than guessing replay or skip.
scope_guard: This proves only the tested serialized single-writer symbolic cases with deterministic intent/effect identity and an explicit freshness/completeness model. It does not prove safety for concurrent writers, target corruption, nondeterministic ids, distributed consensus, stale certificates outside the modeled generation fence, or liveness when fresh target observation is unavailable.

mechanism_assessment.accepted_scope: safety of stale/partial/identity-ambiguous query handling by exact payload+generation/nonce+freshness fencing
mechanism_assessment.unresolved_child: If target-query freshness/completeness and effect identity cannot be certified from Chat-native observable state, safe recurrence can defer but cannot guarantee exactly-once progress.
